S01: Learn the key terms: Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Extended Reality (XR), and Mixed Reality (MR)
S02: Explore the meanings, differences, and significance of XR, AR, and VR
S03: Explore common perceptions of AR/VR/XR using examples like games, Avatar, and internal views
S04: Understand XR as an umbrella term for all immersive technologies (AR, VR, MR)
S05: Learn the reality-virtuality continuum and the difference between augmented reality and augmented virtuality
S06: See the growth potential of XR using market statistics and the metaverse concept
S07: See the course structure, covering basic concepts, theory, and development using a case study
S08: See the course scope, including the digital heritage project and foundational concepts
